effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When choosing Tactics, if you did not set a Gambit, you may discard this card to choose one Tactic from your Reserve and one eligible card from your Hand as an additional Tactic. Set both face down as your Tactics, or pass.

effects.label: Tactic
effects.text: When you choose this card as your Tactic, if you did not set a Gambit, you may also choose one eligible card from your Hand as an additional Tactic. Set it face down and reveal both together. In the Aftermath, put that card in your Graveyard instead of your Discard Pile.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: At the end of the Aftermath of a battle you did not initiate and won, you may put this card in your Graveyard to advance one position. This movement may start a battle.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: At the end of the Aftermath of a battle you did not initiate and won, put this card in your Graveyard, then advance one position. This movement may start a battle.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Place this card as an Overlay on a Territory you occupy and control.

effects.label: Overlay
effects.text: At the end of this card's owner's turn, if they occupy and control this Territory, they gain 1 Command. When another player gains control of this Territory, put this card in its owner's Graveyard.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you won while defending a Territory you control, place this card on that Territory as an Overlay.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After you use a 1-Command Order, you may discard this card to use your Leader's other 1-Command Order once this turn at its next legal timing without spending Command.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: After you use a 1-Command Order during this battle while this card is face up, you may use your Leader's other 1-Command Order once this turn at its next legal timing without spending Command. If you use that Order, put this card in your Graveyard after it takes effect.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Play only during Denouement if you won a battle you initiated this turn. Advance one Position. This movement may create a pending battle. If it does, you cannot set a Gambit or use Orders during that battle. Form your Reserve with one fewer card for each earlier battle after the first that you fought this turn. This may reduce your Reserve to zero cards. Put this card in your Graveyard after this movement.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: At the end of the Aftermath of a battle you initiated and won, you may advance one position. Apply the same follow-up-battle restrictions. Put this card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: During Onset while defending a Territory you control, you may put this card in your Graveyard. If you do, after Tactics are revealed, draw two cards into your Reserve. You may play one face up as an additional Tactic. If you lose, after you retreat, the attacker captures that Territory.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If you are defending a Territory you control, after Tactics are revealed, draw two cards into your Reserve. You may play one face up as an additional Tactic. If you lose, after you retreat, the attacker captures that Territory. In the Aftermath, put this card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After you lose a battle and retreat, when your opponent would use an Order or card effect to enter your position during that turn, you may discard this card to prevent that movement. No Command is spent, and any card used for that effect returns to its owner's Hand. That Order cannot be used again that turn, and that specific card cannot be played again that turn.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you lose and retreat, bank this card.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card with one card from your Hand that has a Tactic or Battle effect face down beneath it.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: If this card leaves play without deploying the stored card, put that card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed in a battle involving you, you may discard this card to play the stored card face up as an additional Tactic. In the Aftermath, put the stored card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed, you may replace this card with an eligible card from your Hand, face up. If you replace it, put this card in your Graveyard. Otherwise, put this card in your Discard Pile in the Aftermath.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After you win a battle in which you used no Orders, you may discard this card to gain 1 Command.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If you win this battle and used no Orders during it, gain 1 Command.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: In the Aftermath of a battle you won, you may put this card in your Graveyard to put all opposing Tactics from that battle in their owner's Graveyard instead of their Discard Pile and make the opponent retreat one additional position. You cannot move, capture a Territory, or use an Order as a result of that victory.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you won, you may apply the same effect and put this card in your Graveyard.
